Build prompt

Rebuild this animation 1:1: Airbnb's "Refer a host, earn a cash reward" screen - a 3D illustration of hosts assembles person by person with a springy pop while the headline, How it works steps, pink Start hosting button, and "View your referrals" link stagger in from below.

## Integration
Integration: stack-agnostic spec - springs given as stiffness/damping, timed motions as duration + curve; map every value to your framework and animation library of choice.

## Scene
White referral screen. Headline "Refer a host, earn a cash reward" top-left with a back chevron. Center: a 3D illustration of standing hosts that grows from one person to a group of four (olive, pink, and tan figures). Below: "How it works" with three rows (Tell us who you're referring / Send them your referral link / Get rewarded), a full-width pink "Start hosting" button, and a centered "View your referrals" text link.

## Motion spec
Pattern: staggered content reveal with assembling 3D illustration.
- Headline fades in first (200ms ease-out).
- The 3D hosts assemble one at a time, 120ms apart: each figure scales up from 0.6 with a spring (~320/16, slight overshoot) and a soft drop shadow fades under it.
- The assembled group holds with a subtle idle bob (translateY +/-2pt, 2.4s sine).
- "How it works" rows fade up in sequence (translateY 12pt -> 0, 250ms each, 80ms stagger).
- The pink button slides up (translateY 20pt -> 0, 280ms ease-out) and the referrals link fades in last (150ms).

## Calibration
- The figures pop one by one - the group never appears all at once.
- Stagger delays are short (80-120ms); the whole entrance completes in about a second.

## Reduced motion
All content fades in together over 250ms; the illustration appears fully assembled.

## Don't miss
- The pink button is the only saturated element - it enters after the steps so the eye lands on it last.
- The illustration's drop shadow arrives with the figures, not before.
